shared_elements: row of small rectangles forming a horizontal band (bared teeth in A; hatched/panelled band in B)
repeated arc or crescent shapes (scalloped headdress in A; arcs/loops in the upper register of B)
justification: The only reasonably specific correspondence is a horizontal band of small repeated rectangles crossing the stone (the grid of teeth in A, the panelled/hatched band in B) together with sets of repeated arcs above it, both worked in soft, rounded low relief on pale stone. Otherwise they are quite different objects: A is a compact three-dimensional head with a scalloped cap and grimacing mouth, while B is a flat vertical slab organised into registers of profile animals and abstract motifs, with no figural or zoomorphic imagery shared between them.
